<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "brief": "## Problem\nUsers struggle to assign roles to team members and map existing groups to claim functions, leading to manual work and delays. Without clear guidance or system support, workflows are disrupted and onboarding becomes inefficient.\n\n## Who is affected\n- Claims administrators and team leaders are affected, as they ask for walkthroughs on assigning tasks to specific roles [i:0aa64b35164792c4] and assigning roles to new team members [i:70f1c212cdbb1114].\n- IT or system administrators are affected when they cannot map existing sign-on groups to claim roles, causing extra manual work [i:97544f8910aab437].\n- Managers setting up team workflows are affected when they need clarity on how claim allocation works across different lines [i:ec873e962ea27d1d].\n\n## Evidence\nThe issue has been raised by 5 accounts across 2 routes, generating 6 total mentions [i:0aa64b35164792c4][i:70f1c212cdbb1114][i:97544f8910aab437][i:a6118dc3758577e2][i:b396c2a22824afc3][i:ec873e962ea27d1d]. Support tickets account for 4 mentions [i:0aa64b35164792c4][i:70f1c212cdbb1114][i:a6118dc3758577e2][i:b396c2a22824afc3], and onboarding queries account for 2 mentions [i:97544f8910aab437][i:ec873e962ea27d1d].\n\nCustomer quotes directly illustrate the confusion, such as a user asking, Could you walk me through how to assign tasks to specific roles for claims handling? [i:0aa64b35164792c4] and another stating, when assigning staff to different claim roles, we can’t seem to map our existing sign-on groups to those roles directly... that mapping isn’t available, and it’s causing extra manual work for our team. [i:97544f8910aab437]. Users also ask for walkthroughs on assigning roles to new claims handlers [i:a6118dc3758577e2] and report being stuck on assigning roles for new staff [i:b396c2a22824afc3].\n\nThe total ARR from these 5 accounts is 3090000.0 GBP [i:0aa64b35164792c4][i:70f1c212cdbb1114][i:97544f8910aab437][i:a6118dc3758577e2][i:b396c2a22824afc3][i:ec873e962ea27d1d].\n\n## Why now\nIn the last 90 days, only 1 renewal has occurred from among these 5 accounts [i:0aa64b35164792c4][i:70f1c212cdbb1114][i:97544f8910aab437][i:a6118dc3758577e2][i:b396c2a22824afc3][i:ec873e962ea27d1d]. The consistent stream of support and onboarding requests in September and October 2026 indicates ongoing friction [i:0aa64b35164792c4][i:70f1c212cdbb1114][i:97544f8910aab437][i:a6118dc3758577e2][i:b396c2a22824afc3][i:ec873e962ea27d1d].",

<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the quoted customer statements against the cited insights: both quotes in the brief match the insight text verbatim, so no paraphrase is presented as a quote. I verified the counts (5 accounts, 6 mentions, 2 routes, 4 support and 2 onboarding mentions), the ARR total of 3,090,000 GBP, and the 1 renewal in the last 90 days against the fact sheet — all match. The date range cited (September and October 2026) is consistent with the insight dates (2026-09-06 through 2026-10-30), and the affected-person descriptions are supported by the cited quotes without overstating scope.", "verdict": "pass"}
